classification.difficultyReason: Infer an unlabelled negative integer, where part (b) says AB is three times BC so the 12-unit gap must be reframed as four equal parts, and a multipart item is rated by its hardest essential part.

children.label: a
children.prompt: The distance from A to B is the same as the distance from B to C. Find the value of B.

spec.description: Horizontal number line with arrowheads at both ends. Equally spaced positions A, B and C have downward identifying arrows and downward ticks. Only A and C have numerical labels below the line.
spec.mathematics: A=-13 and C=-5. AB=BC. Native coordinates place B exactly halfway between A and C.
spec.answerVisibility: The numerical value of B is absent from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
From $-13$ to $-5$ is $8$ units. B is halfway between A and C.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Each half}&=8\div2\\\text{Each half}&=4\\B&=-13+4\\B&=-9\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: The distance from A to B is three times the distance from B to C. Find the value of B.

spec.description: Horizontal number line with arrowheads at both ends. Downward identifying arrows label A, B and C. A and C have downward ticks and numerical labels; B lies nearer C and has no numerical label.
spec.mathematics: A=-15 and C=-3. AB=3BC. Native positions A=(1,0), B=(4,0), C=(5,0) implement the stated 3:1 distance relationship.
spec.answerVisibility: The numerical value of B is absent from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
From $-15$ to $-3$ is $12$ units. A to C contains $3+1=4$ equal intervals. B is one interval to the left of C.
$$\begin{align*}\text{One interval}&=12\div4\\\text{One interval}&=3\\B&=-3-3\\B&=-6\end{align*}$$
